title: Exclude guarded P104 owned-capture deletions (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact #7314, independent forward and reverse walks agree on all 72 owned lifetime IDs and 516 ordered operand accesses. No paid fresh-INIT/ADD capture has a common strictly higher-rank read chart. There are zero equal-rank cases. The six otherwise eligible descents were separately priced and excluded at their first source ADD by exact input coordinates. Each owned row has a nonzero coefficient where all other live cocharted rows have coefficient zero, including all 19 public donor incidences. Zero cases remain unresolved within scope.

The scope deletes one guarded capture lifetime and redirects every original source-only ADD to one existing paid public donor at the unchanged read chart and clocks. The complete 17-copy invoice has 110,536 paid positions, 22,461 productive fields and rank surplus 1,424. The relaxed stock upper prices all 47 owned MOVEs once at about 1896.7038062781314 raw. The best single lower-case price is about 33.91417798 raw. The compatible saving upper is zero.

## Task, overlap and replay

Round 64 of [Discussion #7111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111). Exact #7314 head 9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91 is independently reproduced at κ 0.003646221436446, with the exact #7113 caller. #7307 and #7308 check individual owned MOVEs on #7277. This contribution checks whole literal lifetimes and tests #7308’s relevant separating coordinates directly on #7314. The branch retains the #7257 replay prerequisites.

~~~sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-guarded-owned-capture-bound/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-guarded-owned-capture-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-guarded-owned-capture-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

Standalone replay authenticates exact sources and reproduces seven receipts, including structural, signed separator, stale-price and changed-caller controls. Registered replay, committed bytes and modes, Git-free export and six navigation tests passed locally. A changed donor itinerary or retimed read remains open.
